languageEscapeMeaning: Two source reverse-solidus bytes in a quoted JS literal encode one U+005C search character; unchanged source literal, not two-character search.
assertCalleeOrder: Original assert reference/callee evaluation remains before its argument expressions; newlocals initialized outside that call. If no operand reached, generic prior A04 label remains. Call-provider failure after arguments reports last reached operand/result, not unique assertion-refusal cause.
valueFlow: Comma expressions yield their last actual operand value; && uses same shortcircuit and returns same operand value. No boolean cast added. Original assert receives same one argument and no message; rethrow uses same caughtvalue.
noAcceptanceChange: No name normalization, path canonicalization, fallback, extra allowed tar types, extraction, bypass or revised predicates.
